links.plain: height-and-sway alarm firing rapid heart-rate and palm-sweat adrenaline
links.function: triggers sympathetic autonomic arousal in response to the 230-foot canyon drop and swaying planks
links.narration_bridge: Drives the immediate canyon arousal gap in Dutton & Aron (1974, JPSP, SRC1).

links.plain: internal body reader registering a pounding chest without a built-in cause label
links.function: relays intense cardiac and visceral interoceptive sensations upward for conscious emotional interpretation
links.narration_bridge: Mapped in humans by Critchley & Garfinkel (2017, SRC3) and Kleckner, Barrett et al. (2017, Nature Human Behaviour, SRC4).

links.plain: meaning-maker blending unlabelled adrenaline onto the person standing right in front of you
links.function: combines ambiguous visceral arousal with immediate social cues, amplifying perceived chemistry—or cooling once pulse settles
links.narration_bridge: Explains the 50.0% vs 12.5% bridge surge and the 65%-to-30% bench cooldown in Dutton & Aron (1974, SRC1).
